usedFor: Zoho Sign holds documents out for signature, and Sangam CRM keeps the lead that “Create or Update Lead” refreshes.

bestTemplate.name: “When a document is approved by a recipient” in Zoho Sign, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: An approved document shows a deal moving, so the lead updates by ID, email or phone.

watchOut: “When a document sent for signature or approval expires” is separate, so expiries need their own template.
